claim: Is Thingiverse still the “go-to” for uploading/downloading ... - Reddit
summary: Thingiverse is in a bad state technically and owned by a shit company that doesn't care. But it's still the best site out there in terms of content and layout. Prusaprinters is nice and getting better. But a lot of people just publish stuff from Thingiverse that they don't even own in order to get credits for filament. People even create bots ...
